articles.title: SEC Commissioner Peirce counters views that crypto rule will foster synthetic tokens
articles.snippet: Hester Peirce, the commissioner behind the SEC's Crypto Task Force, made statements on the now-delayed proposal, perhaps tamping down mistaken beliefs.

articles.title: Crypto majors stuck in tight range as altcoin rotation picks up steam
articles.snippet: Bitcoin holds between $76,000 and $78,000 while AI tokens and HYPE surge; derivatives signal calm conditions with volatility selling dominating options markets.

articles.title: Satoshi’s 1.1 million bitcoin and millions more can be saved from quantum attack, says expert
articles.snippet: Researchers at the privacy-centric blockchain startup say their multi-layer quantum defense will feature a soft fork to freeze and protect dormant BTC.

articles.title: NYSE owner ICE to launch oil-linked futures with OKX
articles.snippet: ICE and OKX plan to launch oil-linked perpetual futures based on Brent and WTI benchmarks, bringing crypto derivatives further into traditional energy markets under licensing restrictions.

articles.title: Spotify and Universal Launch AI Remix Tool for Fan-Made Covers
articles.snippet: Spotify and Universal Music Group say their new licensed AI remix platform will let fans create song covers and remixes while compensating participating artists and songwriters.
